records.name: Saulcerīte
records.facts_used: Saulcerīte: The Latvian dictionary explains the name’s formation through saule, sun, and cerēt, to hope; it is Rainis’s character name in Zelta zirgs. This is a specific connection with Latvian vocabulary. The explanation concerns the form discussed in the dictionary; similar spellings require their own origin and attestation checks. The play premiered at the New Riga Theatre on 26 December 1909. Siliņš’s dictionary dates the use of Saulcerīte: 1932. Its calendar year is 1928. This records use of the particular name in Latvia. The entry cannot automatically be transferred to similar spellings or treated as the moment the entire name family originated.
